summary: Recent updates to WebRTC, the technology behind video calls, include the addition of **RTCTransportStats.selectedCandidatePairChanges**. This feature enhances the ability to track changes in the network paths used for media streams, providing better insights into connection quality and optimization. Additionally, an improvement was made in audio processing with the introduction of an error handling mechanism in AudioPacketizer, which helps ensure more reliable audio playback by accurately calculating sample counts. These enhancements contribute to a smoother and more efficient user experience during video calls and streaming.
